prior_year_events.impact_description: A split reinsurance to close contract for 2018 and prior years of account, and a quota share arrangement for discontinued lines written in 2019 and subsequent years, transferred significant liabilities, resulting in a large gross release.
The 2019 and Prior YOA RITC and the 2020 YOA quota share contract were reflected in the 2022 Income Statement and contributed to movements in prior year claims.
Catastrophe losses in 2022 were GBP 91.0 million (8.4% of loss ratio), higher than 2023, contributing to prior period strengthening in 2022.
Ukraine claims had impacted the 2022 loss ratio by 9.1%, with reserving levels maintained in 2023, suggesting adverse development in 2022.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a significant gross prior year reserve release of GBP 1,271.2 million, primarily driven by the 2023 RiverStone contracts. These transactions included a reinsurance to close (RITC) for the 2018 and prior years of account, and a quota share arrangement for discontinued lines from 2019 and subsequent years, transferring substantial liabilities to RiverStone Syndicate 3500. This resulted in a 41.75% reduction in gross claims outstanding compared to the opening balance. The underlying net prior period reserve movement, excluding these contracts, was a reduction of GBP 25.3 million.
raw_causal_phrases: Movements arising from prior year claims line above includes movements relating to RiverStone contracts entered into during the current and prior year

A (split) reinsurance to close contract for the 2018 and prior years of account. This transfers the financial benefits/liabilities for all future cash flows to RiverStone Syndicate 3500. ('2023 RITC')
A quota share arrangement, also with RiverStone Syndicate 3500, that allowed for the discontinued lines written in 2019 and subsequent years of account to be fully reinsured. ('Quota Share')

data.data_quality_notes: The reported gross prior year development of -1,271.2m is heavily influenced by the 2023 RiverStone reinsurance to close (RITC) and quota share transactions, which transferred significant liabilities. The underlying net prior period reserve movement, excluding these contracts, was a reduction of GBP 25.3m as stated in the Underwriting Performance section. The claims development triangle is distorted by the RITC transactions and was not used for PYD calculation.
